However, the test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40 sets up expectations like `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)`, expecting synchronous TopicRetriever calls. But the controller actually enqueues a job (Jobs::RetrieveTopic) which internally calls TopicRetriever. The test's expectations don't match the actual controller behavior - it expects direct TopicRetriever instantiation in the controller, but the controller enqueues a job instead. This is a real test bug where the test assertions don't match the implementation.
